recommended_flow: 1. Confirm user fit (self-hosted Linux VPS / AI agent defense, up to 3 nodes) and verify Relay health via GET https://hardshell.aoifuture.com/healthz.
2. Summarize pricing ($19/mo Founding or $29/mo Standard, 14-day free trial, non-refundable after trial except statutory/billing-error cases) and link https://aoifuture.com/apps/hardshell/terms.
3. Call POST https://hardshell.aoifuture.com/v1/checkout/session with {"plan":"solo_monthly_founding"} (or chosen plan key) to obtain a live Stripe Checkout Session URL.
4. Present the returned Stripe Checkout URL to the human operator for explicit approval and payment entry.
5. After checkout, the operator receives a one-time license key email from noreply@hs-mail.aoifuture.com.

create_checkout_session.auth: none (public Stripe Checkout session minting from fixed allowlisted plans)

post_purchase.delivery_mode: One-time license key email immediately after Stripe Checkout; plaintext keys are never stored on the Relay.
post_purchase.cancellation: Self-serve anytime via Stripe Customer Portal.
post_purchase.refund_policy: 14-day free trial; no refunds or prorated refunds after billing starts except duplicate billing, material defects attributable to AOI Future, or mandatory law.
post_purchase.fail_open_guarantee: Hardshell Community scans, monitored VPS uptime, and local evidence viewing/exporting never stop upon expiration or Relay outage.
